[[File:Icefiend icon.png|left]]
'''Icefiends''' are monsters normally found on top of [[Ice Mountain]], but icefiends in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] are a stronger, higher-levelled variant than their overworld counterparts.  Icefiends may be assigned as a [[Slayer assignment]] from a [[Slayer Master]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=September Game Jam - This Week In RuneScape|date=18 September 2023}}
** Fixed an issue that meant the Icefiends within the God Wars Dungeon were set to level 1. They are now level 84 as intended.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Wilderness Reborn & New Quest - This Week In RuneScape|date=1 August 2022}}
** Icefiends have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (23 November 2015)|date=23 November 2015}}
** Corrected the melee attack accuracy for the following NPCs: [[Dagannoth Mother]], Dominion Tower Dagannoth Mother, [[Temple at Senntisten]] quest fiends and [[Cockatrices]].

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (26 August 2014)|date=26 August 2014}}
** [[Pyrefiend]] and icefiend models and animations have been updated to use the God Wars models and animations.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (4 December 2012)|date=4 December 2012}}
** Icefiends have been updated.

* {{UL|type=update|update=God Wars: Remastered|date=5 September 2012}}
** Icefiends in the God Wars Dungeon have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (8 March 2011)|date=8 March 2011}}
** Icefiends now correctly drop [[impious ashes]].
}}

==Trivia==
* Icefiends don't count towards a [[slayer task]] when [[recoil]]ed to death. This bug has been known since at least 2015, and has yet to be fixed. The only way to finish the task is to get someone else to [[co-op]] with and have them kill the icefiends.
